term: What the critic will not see yet
definition: The gaps the draft still has. Each one would leave the critic unable to judge the house, so a record with a gap is not checked, sent to the bench or downloaded until it is filled.
basis: docs/workbench.md, Transcription since Phase 17: the record "lists what the critic will not see yet: every gap the draft still has", and "A record with a gap is not checked, sent to the bench or downloaded."
